📍 Khadija Girls' School — West Deir al-Balah, Deir al-Balah

Full description

Israeli air strikes (fighter jets fired three missiles) on a girls' school in Deir al-Balah, central Gaza, killed at least 30 people and wounded over 100 on Saturday, the Palestinian health ministry said. Khadija Girls' School was sheltering over 4,000 displaced Palestinians, according to civil defence officials in the enclave. A field hospital was also operating inside the school complex.
